local function _texProp(target)
	if target and target:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then return "ColorMap" end
	if target and target:IsA("MeshPart") then return "TextureID" end
	return "Texture"
end

-- Playback state for one target. mode: "Loop" / "PingPong" / anything else = OneShot (an
-- EnumItem is accepted). framerate clamps to 0.1 so 0 can't divide.
function MeshFlipbook.layerState(target, frames, mode, framerate, startRandom, reverse)
	if typeof(mode) == "EnumItem" then mode = mode.Name end
	if not framerate or framerate < 0.1 then framerate = 0.1 end
	local n = #frames
	return {
		target = target, frames = frames, n = n, mode = mode,
		frameDelay = 1 / framerate,
		startOffset = startRandom and math.random(0, n - 1) or 0,
		reverse = reverse == true,
		lastFrame = -1,
	}
end

-- Frame shown at `elapsed` seconds. Loop cycles at the framerate, PingPong runs forward then
-- back at the framerate, OneShot spreads the sequence once over `lifetime`. startOffset and
-- reverse apply on top.
function MeshFlipbook.frameIndex(state, elapsed, lifetime)
	local n = state.n
	local frameIndex
	if state.mode == "Loop" then
		frameIndex = (math.floor(elapsed / state.frameDelay) + state.startOffset) % n + 1
	elseif state.mode == "PingPong" and n > 1 then
		local period = 2 * n - 2
		local k = (math.floor(elapsed / state.frameDelay) + state.startOffset) % period
		if k >= n then k = period - k end
		frameIndex = k + 1
	else
		frameIndex = math.min(math.floor(elapsed / math.max(lifetime, 0.001) * n) + 1, n)
		frameIndex = (frameIndex - 1 + state.startOffset) % n + 1
	end
	if state.reverse then frameIndex = n - frameIndex + 1 end
	return frameIndex
end

-- The frame a OneShot sequence must end on.
function MeshFlipbook.finalFrame(state)
	local n = state.n
	local frameIndex = (n - 1 + state.startOffset) % n + 1
	if state.reverse then frameIndex = n - frameIndex + 1 end
	return frameIndex
end

local function _isOneShot(state)
	return state.mode ~= "Loop" and state.mode ~= "PingPong"
end

-- One task cycling `target` off pData._effectiveElapsed so Timescale, FreezeTime, Pause and
-- signed-reverse all affect playback. Wall-clock cap is the safety exit; primary teardown is
-- the Heartbeat destroying the visual. OneShot lands on its final frame before death.
local function _run(pData, particle, decals, target, lifetime, mode)
	if #decals == 0 then return end
	local framerate = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(particle.FlipbookFramerate)
	local state = MeshFlipbook.layerState(target, decals, mode, framerate, particle.FlipbookStartRandom, particle.FlipbookReverse)
	local startTime = os.clock()
	local prop = _texProp(target)

	task.spawn(function()
		while os.clock() - startTime < lifetime * 4 do
			if not target or not target.Parent then return end
			if pData and (not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent) then break end
			local elapsed = (pData and pData._effectiveElapsed) or (os.clock() - startTime)
			local frameIndex = MeshFlipbook.frameIndex(state, elapsed, lifetime)
			if frameIndex ~= state.lastFrame then
				_writeFrame(target, prop, decals[frameIndex])
				state.lastFrame = frameIndex
			end
			task.wait()
		end
		if _isOneShot(state) and target and target.Parent then
			_writeFrame(target, prop, decals[MeshFlipbook.finalFrame(state)])
		end
	end)
end

local function _playable(mode)
	return mode == Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.Loop or mode == Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot
		or mode == Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.PingPong
end

-- Target is Decal (Texture) or SurfaceAppearance (ColorMap); _texProp picks the slot.
-- pData is required for Timescale/FreezeTime/Pause/reverse-Timescale-aware frame indexing;
-- nil pData falls back to wall-clock elapsed for backwards compat.
function MeshFlipbook.Flip(pData, particle, decals: {string}, target, lifetime)
	if not particle or not _playable(particle.FlipbookMode) then return end
	_run(pData, particle, decals, target, lifetime, particle.FlipbookMode.Name)
end

-- Every flipbook set under a MeshFlipbooks folder: sub-folders keyed by name, numbered frames
-- directly in the folder under "" (the legacy single flipbook).
function MeshFlipbook.GetFlipbookSets(folder: Folder)
	local sets = {}
	local flat = MeshFlipbook.GetSortedTextures(folder)
	if #flat > 0 then sets[""] = flat end
	for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Folder") then
			local textures = MeshFlipbook.GetSortedTextures(child)
			if #textures > 0 then sets[child.Name] = textures end
		end
	end
	return sets
end

-- One task per particle steps every layer's flipbook off pData._effectiveElapsed;
-- OneShot layers land on their final frame when the loop ends.
function MeshFlipbook.FlipLayers(pData, layers, lifetime)
	local active = {}
	for _, layer in ipairs(layers) do
		if layer.flip then table.insert(active, layer.flip) end
	end
	if #active == 0 then return end
	local startTime = os.clock()
	task.spawn(function()
		while os.clock() - startTime < lifetime * 4 do
			if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return end
			local elapsed = pData._effectiveElapsed or (os.clock() - startTime)
			for i = 1, #active do
				local state = active[i]
				if state.target.Parent then
					local frameIndex = MeshFlipbook.frameIndex(state, elapsed, lifetime)
					if frameIndex ~= state.lastFrame then
						_writeFrame(state.target, "Texture", state.frames[frameIndex])
						state.lastFrame = frameIndex
					end
				end
			end
			task.wait()
		end
		for i = 1, #active do
			local state = active[i]
			if _isOneShot(state) and state.target.Parent then
				_writeFrame(state.target, "Texture", state.frames[MeshFlipbook.finalFrame(state)])
			end
		end
	end)
end

function MeshFlipbook.FlipBeam(pData, flipbookParticle, decals: {string}, beam, lifetime)
	if not flipbookParticle or not decals or not _playable(flipbookParticle.FlipbookMode) then return end
	_run(pData, flipbookParticle, decals, beam, lifetime, flipbookParticle.FlipbookMode.Name)
end

return MeshFlipbook

--[[
	GetData Mixin  -  Particle:GetData(item) reads every config attribute into a flat data table.
	Returns nil for non-transformed items.
]]

local MeshFlipMod = require(script.Parent.Flipbook)
local DecalLayersMod = require(script.Parent.DecalLayers)
local MeshFramesMod = require(script.Parent.MeshFrames)
local TypeRegistry = require(script.Parent.TypeRegistry)
local AxisLinksMod = require(script.Parent.AxisLinks)
local EventsSchema = require(script.Parent.EventsSchema)

local GetDataRig = require(script.Parent.GetDataRig)
local GetDataScreen = require(script.Parent.GetDataScreen)

-- Enum.X[name] throws on unknown names; pcall + default keeps emit alive on bad migrations.
local function safeEnum(enumType, name, default)
	if not name then return default end
	local ok, val = pcall(function() return enumType[name] end)
	return (ok and val) or default
end

-- Read raw <axis>LinkedTo, hand to AxisLinks.sanitize for filtering.
local function readAxisLinks(config)
	local raw = {
		SizeX = config:GetAttribute("SizeXLinkedTo"), SizeY = config:GetAttribute("SizeYLinkedTo"), SizeZ = config:GetAttribute("SizeZLinkedTo"),
		RotSpeedX = config:GetAttribute("RotSpeedXLinkedTo"), RotSpeedY = config:GetAttribute("RotSpeedYLinkedTo"), RotSpeedZ = config:GetAttribute("RotSpeedZLinkedTo"),
		PosOffsetX = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetXLinkedTo"), PosOffsetY = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetYLinkedTo"), PosOffsetZ = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetZLinkedTo"),
		RotX = config:GetAttribute("RotXLinkedTo"), RotY = config:GetAttribute("RotYLinkedTo"), RotZ = config:GetAttribute("RotZLinkedTo"),
		PosX = config:GetAttribute("PosXLinkedTo"), PosY = config:GetAttribute("PosYLinkedTo"), PosZ = config:GetAttribute("PosZLinkedTo"),
	}
	return AxisLinksMod.sanitize(raw)
end

return function(Particle)

-- Resolve `item`'s authored config into a flat `data` table used by every emit /
-- update path: graphs, NumberRanges, Booleans, Link target, AxisLinks, EmitMode, etc.
function Particle:GetData(item)
	local data = {}

	local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
	if not config then return nil end

	local ep = item:FindFirstChild("EmitParent")
	data.EmitParent = ep and ep:IsA("ObjectValue") and ep.Value or nil

	-- LinkSource (None / Camera / Object) picks what; LinkMode (Weld / Follow / Pivot) picks how.
	local lk = item:FindFirstChild("Link")
	local linkedInst = lk and lk:IsA("ObjectValue") and lk.Value or nil
	local linkSource = item:GetAttribute("LinkSource")
	if not linkSource then linkSource = linkedInst and "Object" or "None" end
	if linkSource == "Camera" then
		data.Link = workspace.CurrentCamera
	elseif linkSource == "Object" then
		data.Link = linkedInst
	else
		data.Link = nil
	end
	data.LinkMode = item:GetAttribute("LinkMode") or "Follow"
	data.LinkAxes = LinkCF.readAxes(item)

	data.RenderTemplate = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")

	-- Events snapshot frozen at emit; runtime fire reads only this, never live cfg.
	data.Events = EventsSchema.readEnabled(item)

	local tkf = config:GetAttribute("TotalKeyFrames") or 0
	data.TotalKeyFrames = tkf > 0 and tkf or 100

	data.CheckEnabled = function() return config.Parent ~= nil and config:GetAttribute("Enabled") == true end

	-- MODEL
	if item:IsA("Model") then
		data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0
		data.DirMode = config:GetAttribute("DirMode") or ((config:GetAttribute("VelocityVectored") and "Local") or "RigidLocal")
		data.VelocityVectored = (data.DirMode == "Local")
		data.InvertMotion = config:GetAttribute("InvertMotion") or false
		data.RotMode = config:GetAttribute("RotMode") or "OverLife"
		data.RotOrder = config:GetAttribute("RotOrder") or "Global"
		data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(1)
		data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10

		data.EmissionDirection = safeEnum(Enum.NormalId, config:GetAttribute("EmissionDirection"), Enum.NormalId.Top)

		data.ParticleData = {
			SpreadAngle = config:GetAttribute("SpreadAngle") or Vector2.new(0, 0),
			Acceleration = config:GetAttribute("Acceleration") or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
			Drag = config:GetAttribute("Drag") or 0,
		}

		data.Speed = config:GetAttribute("Speed")
		data.Scale = config:GetAttribute("Scale")
		data.Timescale = config:GetAttribute("Timescale")

		data.RotX = config:GetAttribute("RotX") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.RotY = config:GetAttribute("RotY") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.RotZ = config:GetAttribute("RotZ") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.RotXEven = config:GetAttribute("RotXEven") == true
		data.RotYEven = config:GetAttribute("RotYEven") == true
		data.RotZEven = config:GetAttribute("RotZEven") == true

		data.PosX = config:GetAttribute("PosX") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.PosY = config:GetAttribute("PosY") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.PosZ = config:GetAttribute("PosZ") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.PosXEven = config:GetAttribute("PosXEven") == true
		data.PosYEven = config:GetAttribute("PosYEven") == true
		data.PosZEven = config:GetAttribute("PosZEven") == true
		data.PosMode = config:GetAttribute("PosMode") or "Local"
		data.DisplacementMode = config:GetAttribute("DisplacementMode") or "Global"

		data.RotSpeedX = config:GetAttribute("RotSpeedX")
		data.RotSpeedY = config:GetAttribute("RotSpeedY")
		data.RotSpeedZ = config:GetAttribute("RotSpeedZ")

		data.PosOffsetX = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetX")
		data.PosOffsetY = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetY")
		data.PosOffsetZ = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetZ")
		data.Turbulence = config:GetAttribute("Turbulence")
		data.TurbulenceFrequency = config:GetAttribute("TurbulenceFrequency") or 1

		data.Orientation = config:GetAttribute("Orientation") or "None"
		data.ZOffset = config:GetAttribute("ZOffset") or 0

		data.AxisLinks = readAxisLinks(config)
		data.Pool = config:GetAttribute("Pool")
		-- Gates descendant Beam's TextureLength * pFactor in UpdateBeam (parent-scale block).
		data.ScaleTextureLength = config:GetAttribute("ScaleTextureLength")
		-- Nested-particle motion scaling. ScaleMotion default true (~= false); ScaleRotation
		-- default false (== true). Carried into parentScaleInfo for nested particles to read.
		data.ScaleMotion = config:GetAttribute("ScaleMotion") ~= false
		data.ScaleRotation = config:GetAttribute("ScaleRotation") == true

		return data
	end

	-- BLUR
	if item:IsA("BlurEffect") then
		data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0
		data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(1)
		data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10
		data.BlurSize = config:GetAttribute("BlurSize")
		data.Timescale = config:GetAttribute("Timescale")
		return data
	end

	-- BLOOM
	if item:IsA("BloomEffect") then
		data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0
		data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(1)
		data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10
		data.BloomIntensity = config:GetAttribute("BloomIntensity")
		data.BloomSize = config:GetAttribute("BloomSize")
		data.BloomThreshold = config:GetAttribute("BloomThreshold")
		data.Timescale = config:GetAttribute("Timescale")
		return data
	end

	-- COLOR CORRECTION
	if item:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then
		data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0
		data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(1)
		data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10
		data.CCBrightness = config:GetAttribute("CCBrightness")
		data.CCContrast = config:GetAttribute("CCContrast")
		data.CCSaturation = config:GetAttribute("CCSaturation")
		data.CCTintColor = config:GetAttribute("CCTintColor")
		data.Timescale = config:GetAttribute("Timescale")
		return data
	end

	-- ATMOSPHERE
	if item:IsA("Atmosphere") then
		data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0
		data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(1)
		data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10
		data.AtmDensity = config:GetAttribute("AtmDensity")
		data.AtmOffset = config:GetAttribute("AtmOffset")
		data.AtmGlare = config:GetAttribute("AtmGlare")
		data.AtmHaze = config:GetAttribute("AtmHaze")
		data.AtmColor = config:GetAttribute("AtmColor")
		data.AtmDecay = config:GetAttribute("AtmDecay")
		data.AtmTimescale = config:GetAttribute("AtmTimescale")
		return data
	end

	-- IMAGE LABEL
	if item:IsA("ImageLabel") then
		data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0
		data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(1)
		data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10
		data.ImageTransparency      = config:GetAttribute("ImageTransparency")
		data.BackgroundTransparency = config:GetAttribute("BackgroundTransparency")
		data.ImgSpeed               = config:GetAttribute("ImgSpeed")
		data.SizeScaleX             = config:GetAttribute("SizeScaleX")
		data.SizeScaleY             = config:GetAttribute("SizeScaleY")
		data.ImgRotRange            = config:GetAttribute("ImgRotRange") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.ImgRotSpeed            = config:GetAttribute("ImgRotSpeed")
		data.ImgRotMode             = config:GetAttribute("ImgRotMode") or "OverLife"
		data.ImageColor3       = config:GetAttribute("ImageColor3")
		data.BackgroundColor3  = config:GetAttribute("BackgroundColor3")
		data.Image             = config:GetAttribute("Image") or ""
		data.ImgPosition       = config:GetAttribute("Position") or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		data.ImgSizeUDim       = config:GetAttribute("ImgSize") or UDim2.fromOffset(100, 100)
		data.ImgAnchorPoint    = config:GetAttribute("AnchorPoint") or Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		data.ImgZIndex         = config:GetAttribute("ZIndex") or 1
		data.ImgScaleType      = safeEnum(Enum.ScaleType, config:GetAttribute("ScaleType"), Enum.ScaleType.Stretch)
		data.ImgResampleMode   = safeEnum(Enum.ResamplerMode, config:GetAttribute("ResampleMode"), Enum.ResamplerMode.Default)
		data.ImgEmissionAngle  = config:GetAttribute("EmissionAngle") or 90
		data.ImgSpreadAngle    = config:GetAttribute("ImgSpreadAngle") or 0
		data.ImgAcceleration   = config:GetAttribute("ImgAcceleration") or Vector2.new(0, 0)
		data.ImgDrag           = config:GetAttribute("ImgDrag") or 0
		data.ImgInvertMotion   = config:GetAttribute("ImgInvertMotion") or false
		-- FlipbookSource: Decals folder vs Spritesheet grid.
		data.ImgFlipbookSource      = config:GetAttribute("ImgFlipbookSource") or "Decals"
		data.ImgFlipbookMode = safeEnum(Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode, config:GetAttribute("ImgFlipbookMode"), Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.Loop)
		data.ImgFlipbookStartRandom = config:GetAttribute("ImgFlipbookStartRandom") or false
		-- Fallback values must match TypeDataScreen registry defaults.
		data.ImgGridCols            = config:GetAttribute("GridCols") or 8
		data.ImgGridRows            = config:GetAttribute("GridRows") or 1
		data.ImgFlipbookFramerate   = config:GetAttribute("ImgFlipbookFramerate") or NumberRange.new(10)
		data.ImgFlipbookReverse     = config:GetAttribute("ImgFlipbookReverse") or false
		-- Sheet dims stamped at edit time. Trust _SheetSize only when _SheetAsset matches current Image.
		local sSize = config:GetAttribute("_SheetSize")
		local sAsset = config:GetAttribute("_SheetAsset")
		local currentId = (type(data.Image) == "string") and (data.Image:match("rbxassetid://(%d+)") or data.Image:match("^(%d+)$")) or nil
		if typeof(sSize) == "Vector2" and sAsset and sAsset == currentId then data.SheetSize = sSize end
		data.ImageFlipbooks = item:FindFirstChild("ImageFlipbooks")
		data.ImgTimescale = config:GetAttribute("ImgTimescale")
		data.Pool = config:GetAttribute("Pool")
		return data
	end

	-- SOUND  -  native Sound instance (GetDataScreen.luau reader).
	if item:IsA("Sound") then
		return GetDataScreen.readSound(data, config)
	end

	-- POINTLIGHT
	if item:IsA("Light") then
		data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0
		data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(1)
		data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10
		data.PLRange = config:GetAttribute("PLRange")
		data.PLBrightness = config:GetAttribute("PLBrightness")
		data.PLColor = config:GetAttribute("PLColor")
		data.PLTimescale = config:GetAttribute("PLTimescale")
		data.PLAngle = config:GetAttribute("PLAngle")
		data.PLFace = safeEnum(Enum.NormalId, config:GetAttribute("PLFace"), Enum.NormalId.Front)
		data.Shadows = config:GetAttribute("Shadows")
		data.Pool = config:GetAttribute("Pool")
		return data
	end

	-- HIGHLIGHT  -  non-spatial, attached entity. Adornee resolved as ObjectValue child
	-- (falls back to source.Parent when unset). No Link / EmissionDirection / motion.
	if item:IsA("Highlight") then
		data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0
		data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(1)
		data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10
		data.HLFillColor = config:GetAttribute("HLFillColor")
		data.HLFillTransparency = config:GetAttribute("HLFillTransparency")
		data.HLOutlineColor = config:GetAttribute("HLOutlineColor")
		data.HLOutlineTransparency = config:GetAttribute("HLOutlineTransparency")
		data.HLTimescale = config:GetAttribute("HLTimescale")
		data.HLDepthMode = safeEnum(Enum.HighlightDepthMode, config:GetAttribute("HLDepthMode"), Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop)
		local adornee = item:FindFirstChild("Adornee")
		data.Adornee = adornee and adornee:IsA("ObjectValue") and adornee.Value or nil
		data.Pool = config:GetAttribute("Pool")
		return data
	end

	-- TRAILEMITTER  -  Trail with PartIcleProperties Configuration child (full particle pipeline).
	-- Discriminated from directAccess Trail by the config presence check above.
	if item:IsA("Trail") then
		data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0
		data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(2)
		data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10
		data.TEmitTimescale = config:GetAttribute("TEmitTimescale")
		data.TEmitBrightness = config:GetAttribute("TEmitBrightness")
		data.TEmitLightEmission = config:GetAttribute("TEmitLightEmission")
		data.TEmitLightInfluence = config:GetAttribute("TEmitLightInfluence")
		data.TEmitTextureLength = config:GetAttribute("TEmitTextureLength")
		data.TEmitMinLength = config:GetAttribute("TEmitMinLength")
		data.TEmitMaxLength = config:GetAttribute("TEmitMaxLength")
		data.TrailLife = config:GetAttribute("TEmitTrailLife") or NumberRange.new(2)
		-- An empty string is the dropdown's "None": no flipbook plays.
		local trailFlipbookName = config:GetAttribute("TEmitFlipbookMode")
		data.TrailFlipbookMode = if trailFlipbookName == "" then nil else safeEnum(Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode, trailFlipbookName, Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot)
		data.TrailFlipbookFramerate = config:GetAttribute("TEmitFlipbookFramerate") or NumberRange.new(30)
		data.TrailFlipbookStartRandom = config:GetAttribute("TEmitFlipbookStartRandom")
		data.TrailFlipbookReverse = config:GetAttribute("TEmitFlipbookReverse")
		data.TrailFlipbooks = item:FindFirstChild("TrailFlipbooks")
		-- Texture / TextureMode / FaceCamera live on the cloned RT directly; no Configuration mirror.
		data.GraphBlender = item:FindFirstChild("GraphBlender")
		data.Pool = config:GetAttribute("Pool")
		return data
	end

	-- ATTACHMENT
	if item:IsA("Attachment") then
		data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0
		data.DirMode = config:GetAttribute("DirMode") or ((config:GetAttribute("VelocityVectored") and "Local") or "RigidLocal")
		data.VelocityVectored = (data.DirMode == "Local")
		data.InvertMotion = config:GetAttribute("InvertMotion") or false
		data.RotMode = config:GetAttribute("RotMode") or "OverLife"
		data.RotOrder = config:GetAttribute("RotOrder") or "Global"
		data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(1)
		data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10

		data.EmissionDirection = safeEnum(Enum.NormalId, config:GetAttribute("EmissionDirection"), Enum.NormalId.Top)

		data.ParticleData = {
			SpreadAngle = config:GetAttribute("SpreadAngle") or Vector2.new(0, 0),
			Acceleration = config:GetAttribute("Acceleration") or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
			Drag = config:GetAttribute("Drag") or 0,
		}

		data.Speed = config:GetAttribute("Speed")
		data.Timescale = config:GetAttribute("Timescale")

		data.RotX = config:GetAttribute("RotX") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.RotY = config:GetAttribute("RotY") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.RotZ = config:GetAttribute("RotZ") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.RotXEven = config:GetAttribute("RotXEven") == true
		data.RotYEven = config:GetAttribute("RotYEven") == true
		data.RotZEven = config:GetAttribute("RotZEven") == true

		data.PosX = config:GetAttribute("PosX") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.PosY = config:GetAttribute("PosY") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.PosZ = config:GetAttribute("PosZ") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.PosXEven = config:GetAttribute("PosXEven") == true
		data.PosYEven = config:GetAttribute("PosYEven") == true
		data.PosZEven = config:GetAttribute("PosZEven") == true
		data.PosMode = config:GetAttribute("PosMode") or "Local"
		data.DisplacementMode = config:GetAttribute("DisplacementMode") or "Global"

		data.RotSpeedX = config:GetAttribute("RotSpeedX")
		data.RotSpeedY = config:GetAttribute("RotSpeedY")
		data.RotSpeedZ = config:GetAttribute("RotSpeedZ")

		data.PosOffsetX = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetX")
		data.PosOffsetY = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetY")
		data.PosOffsetZ = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetZ")
		data.Turbulence = config:GetAttribute("Turbulence")
		data.TurbulenceFrequency = config:GetAttribute("TurbulenceFrequency") or 1

		data.Orientation = config:GetAttribute("Orientation") or "None"
		data.ZOffset = config:GetAttribute("ZOffset") or 0

		data.AxisLinks = readAxisLinks(config)
		data.Pool = config:GetAttribute("Pool")

		return data
	end

	-- ROCKS  -  debris with ground-collision physics (GetDataRig.luau reader).
	if item:IsA("BasePart") and item:GetAttribute("IsRocks") == true then
		return GetDataRig.readRocks(data, item, config, safeEnum)
	end

	-- ROPE  -  verlet-chain rope (GetDataRig.luau reader).
	if item:IsA("BasePart") and item:GetAttribute("IsRope") == true then
		data.AxisLinks = readAxisLinks(config)
		return GetDataRig.readRope(data, item, config, safeEnum)
	end

	-- CAMERA SHAKE  -  positional trauma shake (GetDataScreen.luau reader).
	if item:IsA("BasePart") and item:GetAttribute("IsCameraShake") == true then
		return GetDataScreen.readCameraShake(data, config)
	end

	-- DISTORTION  -  screen-space glass-canvas field (GetDataScreen.luau reader).
	if item:IsA("BasePart") and item:GetAttribute("IsDistortion") == true then
		return GetDataScreen.readDistortion(data, config)
	end

	-- LIGHTNING  -  procedural part-based bolt (discriminated from Part by IsLightning attr).
	-- SpreadAngle stays FLAT on data (never inside data.ParticleData): Engine's animate
	-- replay indexes freshData.ParticleData.Acceleration unguarded  -  a partial
	-- ParticleData table would crash the Heartbeat.
	if item:IsA("BasePart") and item:GetAttribute("IsLightning") == true then
		data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0
		data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(1)
		data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10

		data.TargetMode = config:GetAttribute("TargetMode") or "Directional"
		local targetOV = item:FindFirstChild("Target")
		data.Target = targetOV and targetOV:IsA("ObjectValue") and targetOV.Value or nil
		data.Length = config:GetAttribute("Length") or NumberRange.new(20)
		data.SpreadAngle = config:GetAttribute("SpreadAngle") or Vector2.new(0, 0)
		data.EmissionDirection = safeEnum(Enum.NormalId, config:GetAttribute("EmissionDirection"), Enum.NormalId.Top)

		-- Bolt-shape props are NumberRanges rolled per bolt. Coerce legacy scalar
		-- attributes (pre-range saves) so old items keep working unedited.
		local function asRange(v, default)
			if typeof(v) == "NumberRange" then return v end
			if typeof(v) == "number" then return NumberRange.new(v) end
			return default
		end
		data.GrowthSpeed = asRange(config:GetAttribute("GrowthSpeed"), NumberRange.new(0))
		data.SegmentCount = asRange(config:GetAttribute("SegmentCount"), NumberRange.new(12))
		data.Amplitude = asRange(config:GetAttribute("Amplitude"), NumberRange.new(0.15))
		data.AmplitudeDecay = asRange(config:GetAttribute("AmplitudeDecay"), NumberRange.new(0.5))
		data.JitterRate = asRange(config:GetAttribute("JitterRate"), NumberRange.new(15))
		data.ForkChance = asRange(config:GetAttribute("ForkChance"), NumberRange.new(0))
		data.ForkDepth = asRange(config:GetAttribute("ForkDepth"), NumberRange.new(0))
		data.ForkLengthScale = asRange(config:GetAttribute("ForkLengthScale"), NumberRange.new(0.4))
		data.Sag = asRange(config:GetAttribute("Sag"), NumberRange.new(0))
		data.SagShape = asRange(config:GetAttribute("SagShape"), NumberRange.new(1))
		data.SeekRadius = asRange(config:GetAttribute("SeekRadius"), NumberRange.new(30))
		data.SeekRetarget = config:GetAttribute("SeekRetarget") == true
		data.SeekBias = config:GetAttribute("SeekBias") or 0
		data.RetargetSpeed = config:GetAttribute("RetargetSpeed") or 0
		data.Gradient = config:GetAttribute("Gradient")
		data.DiskEnabled = config:GetAttribute("DiskEnabled") == true
		data.DiskMode = config:GetAttribute("DiskMode") or "Follow"
		data.DiskSize = config:GetAttribute("DiskSize")
		data.DiskTransparency = config:GetAttribute("DiskTransparency")
		data.DiskBrightness = config:GetAttribute("DiskBrightness")
		data.DiskTexture = config:GetAttribute("DiskTexture") or ""
		data.DiskOffset = config:GetAttribute("DiskOffset") or 0.05
		data.ShapeMode = config:GetAttribute("ShapeMode") or "Jitter"
		data.ScrollSpeed = asRange(config:GetAttribute("ScrollSpeed"), NumberRange.new(1))
		data.Waves = asRange(config:GetAttribute("Waves"), NumberRange.new(3))

		-- Spawn Shape (flat  -  never inside data.ParticleData; Engine replay indexes
		-- ParticleData.Acceleration unguarded).
		data.UseShape = config:GetAttribute("UseShape") == true
		data.Shape = safeEnum(Enum.ParticleEmitterShape, config:GetAttribute("Shape"), Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box)
		data.ShapeInOut = safeEnum(Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut, config:GetAttribute("ShapeInOut"), Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.Outward)
		data.ShapePartial = config:GetAttribute("ShapePartial") or 0
		data.ShapeDirection = config:GetAttribute("ShapeDirection") or "Emitter"
		local shapeOV = item:FindFirstChild("ShapePart")
		data.ShapePart = shapeOV and shapeOV:IsA("ObjectValue") and shapeOV.Value or nil

		-- Spawn offsets / rotation (even-distribution + axis-link machinery shared with Part).
		data.PosX = config:GetAttribute("PosX") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.PosY = config:GetAttribute("PosY") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.PosZ = config:GetAttribute("PosZ") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.PosXEven = config:GetAttribute("PosXEven") == true
		data.PosYEven = config:GetAttribute("PosYEven") == true
		data.PosZEven = config:GetAttribute("PosZEven") == true
		data.PosMode = config:GetAttribute("PosMode") or "Local"
		data.RotX = config:GetAttribute("RotX") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.RotY = config:GetAttribute("RotY") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.RotZ = config:GetAttribute("RotZ") or NumberRange.new(0)
		data.RotXEven = config:GetAttribute("RotXEven") == true
		data.RotYEven = config:GetAttribute("RotYEven") == true
		data.RotZEven = config:GetAttribute("RotZEven") == true
		data.RotOrder = config:GetAttribute("RotOrder") or "Global"
		data.DirMode = config:GetAttribute("DirMode") or "RigidLocal"
		data.AxisLinks = readAxisLinks(config)

		-- Origin motion (flat  -  never inside data.ParticleData).
		data.Speed = config:GetAttribute("Speed")
		data.Acceleration = config:GetAttribute("Acceleration") or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		data.Drag = config:GetAttribute("Drag") or 0
		data.PosOffsetX = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetX")
		data.PosOffsetY = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetY")
		data.PosOffsetZ = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetZ")
		data.DisplacementMode = config:GetAttribute("DisplacementMode") or "Global"
		data.Turbulence = config:GetAttribute("Turbulence")
		data.TurbulenceFrequency = config:GetAttribute("TurbulenceFrequency") or 1

		data.Color = config:GetAttribute("Color")
		data.Brightness = config:GetAttribute("Brightness")
		data.Transparency = config:GetAttribute("Transparency")
		data.Thickness = config:GetAttribute("Thickness")
		data.ThicknessProfile = config:GetAttribute("ThicknessProfile")
		data.Timescale = config:GetAttribute("Timescale")

		data.Pool = config:GetAttribute("Pool")
		return data
	end

	data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0

	-- BEAM
	if item:IsA("Beam") then
		data.GraphBlender = item:FindFirstChild("GraphBlender")
		data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("BeamLifetime") or NumberRange.new(1)
		data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10

		data.BeamFlipbooks = item:FindFirstChild("BeamFlipbooks")
		data.FlipbookParticle = {
			FlipbookMode = safeEnum(Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode, config:GetAttribute("BeamFlipbookMode"), nil),
			FlipbookFramerate = config:GetAttribute("BeamFlipbookFramerate") or nil,
			FlipbookStartRandom = config:GetAttribute("BeamFlipbookStartRandom") or false,
			FlipbookReverse = config:GetAttribute("BeamFlipbookReverse") or false,
		}

		if data.BeamFlipbooks then
			data.CachedBeamTextures = MeshFlipMod.GetSortedBeamTextures(data.BeamFlipbooks)
		end

		data.FaceCamera = config:GetAttribute("FaceCamera")
		data.ZOffset = config:GetAttribute("ZOffset")
		data.TextureMode = safeEnum(Enum.TextureMode, config:GetAttribute("BeamTextureMode"), nil)
		data.BeamProps = {
			Brightness = config:GetAttribute("BeamBrightness"),
			CurveSize0 = config:GetAttribute("CurveSize0"),
			CurveSize1 = config:GetAttribute("CurveSize1"),
			Width0 = config:GetAttribute("Width0"),
			Width1 = config:GetAttribute("Width1"),
			LightEmission = config:GetAttribute("LightEmission"),
			LightInfluence = config:GetAttribute("BeamLightInfluence"),
			Segments = config:GetAttribute("Segments"),
			TextureLength = config:GetAttribute("TextureLength"),
			TextureSpeed = config:GetAttribute("TextureSpeed"),
		}
		data.BeamTimescale = config:GetAttribute("BeamTimescale")
		data.Pool = config:GetAttribute("Pool")
		return data
	end

	-- PART (default)
	DecalLayersMod.readInto(data, item, config)
	MeshFramesMod.readInto(data, item, config)

	data.DirMode = config:GetAttribute("DirMode") or ((config:GetAttribute("VelocityVectored") and "Local") or "RigidLocal")
	data.VelocityVectored = (data.DirMode == "Local")
	data.InvertMotion = config:GetAttribute("InvertMotion") or false
	data.RotMode = config:GetAttribute("RotMode") or "OverLife"
	data.RotOrder = config:GetAttribute("RotOrder") or "Global"
	data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(1)
	data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10

	-- Target acceleration: AccelTarget readable types match getTargetPosition's dispatch
	-- (BasePart, Attachment, Camera, Model via GetPivot, Bone via TransformedWorldCFrame).
	data.AccelerationTowardsInstance = config:GetAttribute("AccelerationTowardsInstance") or false
	data.AccelStrength = config:GetAttribute("AccelStrength") or NumberSequence.new(0)
	do
		local at = item:FindFirstChild("AccelTarget")
		local picked = at and at:IsA("ObjectValue") and at.Value or nil
		if picked and (picked:IsA("BasePart") or picked:IsA("Attachment") or picked:IsA("Camera") or picked:IsA("Model") or picked:IsA("Bone")) then
			data.AccelTarget = picked
		else
			data.AccelTarget = nil
		end
	end
	-- ShapePart override (Part with UseShape=true): if set, particles sample shape volume
	-- + spawn at this BasePart's CFrame instead of the source's. nil = source fallback.
	-- A self-reference (Transform's default) is no override: keep the link-aware source frame.
	do
		local sp = item:FindFirstChild("ShapePart")
		local picked = sp and sp:IsA("ObjectValue") and sp.Value or nil
		if picked and picked:IsA("BasePart") and picked.Parent and picked ~= item then
			data.ShapePart = picked
		else
			data.ShapePart = nil
		end
	end

	data.Shape = safeEnum(Enum.ParticleEmitterShape, config:GetAttribute("Shape"), Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box)
	data.ShapeInOut = safeEnum(Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut, config:GetAttribute("ShapeInOut"), Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.Outward)
	data.EmissionDirection = safeEnum(Enum.NormalId, config:GetAttribute("EmissionDirection"), Enum.NormalId.Top)
	data.UseShape = config:GetAttribute("UseShape") == true
	data.LookAtInitially = config:GetAttribute("LookAtInitially") == true

	data.ParticleData = {
		Shape = data.Shape,
		ShapeInOut = data.ShapeInOut,
		ShapePartial = math.clamp(config:GetAttribute("ShapePartial") or 0, 0, 1),
		UseShape = data.UseShape,
		LookAtInitially = data.LookAtInitially,
		EmissionDirection = data.EmissionDirection,
		SpreadAngle = config:GetAttribute("SpreadAngle") or Vector2.new(0, 0),
		Acceleration = config:GetAttribute("Acceleration") or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
		Drag = config:GetAttribute("Drag") or 0,
		FlipbookMode = safeEnum(Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode, config:GetAttribute("FlipbookMode"), nil),
		FlipbookFramerate = config:GetAttribute("FlipbookFramerate") or nil,
		FlipbookStartRandom = config:GetAttribute("FlipbookStartRandom") or false,
		FlipbookReverse = config:GetAttribute("FlipbookReverse") or false,
	}

	data.Transparency = config:GetAttribute("Transparency")
	data.Color = config:GetAttribute("Color")
	data.Speed = config:GetAttribute("Speed")
	data.Brightness = config:GetAttribute("Brightness")
	data.Timescale = config:GetAttribute("Timescale")

	data.AxisLinks = readAxisLinks(config)

	data.SizeX = config:GetAttribute("SizeX")
	data.SizeY = config:GetAttribute("SizeY")
	data.SizeZ = config:GetAttribute("SizeZ")

	data.RotX = config:GetAttribute("RotX") or NumberRange.new(0)
	data.RotY = config:GetAttribute("RotY") or NumberRange.new(0)
	data.RotZ = config:GetAttribute("RotZ") or NumberRange.new(0)
	data.RotXEven = config:GetAttribute("RotXEven") == true
	data.RotYEven = config:GetAttribute("RotYEven") == true
	data.RotZEven = config:GetAttribute("RotZEven") == true

	data.PosX = config:GetAttribute("PosX") or NumberRange.new(0)
	data.PosY = config:GetAttribute("PosY") or NumberRange.new(0)
	data.PosZ = config:GetAttribute("PosZ") or NumberRange.new(0)
	data.PosXEven = config:GetAttribute("PosXEven") == true
	data.PosYEven = config:GetAttribute("PosYEven") == true
	data.PosZEven = config:GetAttribute("PosZEven") == true
	data.PosMode = config:GetAttribute("PosMode") or "Local"
	data.DisplacementMode = config:GetAttribute("DisplacementMode") or "Global"

	data.RotSpeedX = config:GetAttribute("RotSpeedX")
	data.RotSpeedY = config:GetAttribute("RotSpeedY")
	data.RotSpeedZ = config:GetAttribute("RotSpeedZ")

	data.PosOffsetX = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetX")
	data.PosOffsetY = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetY")
	data.PosOffsetZ = config:GetAttribute("PosOffsetZ")
	data.Turbulence = config:GetAttribute("Turbulence")
	data.TurbulenceFrequency = config:GetAttribute("TurbulenceFrequency") or 1

	data.Orientation = config:GetAttribute("Orientation") or "None"
	data.ZOffset = config:GetAttribute("ZOffset") or 0

	data.Pool = config:GetAttribute("Pool")

	return data
end

end

--[[
	GetDataRig  -  config readers for the rig-based procedural types (Rocks,
	Rope). Split from GetData.luau (500-line cap). All props FLAT on data  -
	never inside data.ParticleData (Engine replay indexes
	ParticleData.Acceleration unguarded; a partial table would crash the step).
]]

local GetDataRig = {}

-- Coerce legacy scalar attributes so pre-range saves keep working unedited.
local function asRange(v, default)
	if typeof(v) == "NumberRange" then return v end
	if typeof(v) == "number" then return NumberRange.new(v) end
	return default
end

function GetDataRig.readRocks(data, item, config, safeEnum)
	data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0
	data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(3)
	data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 2

	data.BurstMode = config:GetAttribute("BurstMode") or "Directional"
	data.EmissionDirection = safeEnum(Enum.NormalId, config:GetAttribute("EmissionDirection"), Enum.NormalId.Top)
	data.SpreadAngle = config:GetAttribute("SpreadAngle") or Vector2.new(25, 25)
	data.Speed = config:GetAttribute("Speed")
	data.ChunkCount = asRange(config:GetAttribute("ChunkCount"), NumberRange.new(6, 10))
	data.ChunkScale = asRange(config:GetAttribute("ChunkScale"), NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.5))

	data.PosX = asRange(config:GetAttribute("PosX"), NumberRange.new(0))
	data.PosY = asRange(config:GetAttribute("PosY"), NumberRange.new(0))
	data.PosZ = asRange(config:GetAttribute("PosZ"), NumberRange.new(0))
	data.PosMode = config:GetAttribute("PosMode") or "Local"
	data.PosXEven = config:GetAttribute("PosXEven") == true
	data.PosYEven = config:GetAttribute("PosYEven") == true
	data.PosZEven = config:GetAttribute("PosZEven") == true

	data.Gravity = asRange(config:GetAttribute("Gravity"), NumberRange.new(196.2))
	data.Bounciness = asRange(config:GetAttribute("Bounciness"), NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.5))
	data.Friction = asRange(config:GetAttribute("Friction"), NumberRange.new(0.3))
	data.TumbleSpeed = asRange(config:GetAttribute("TumbleSpeed"), NumberRange.new(90, 360))
	data.SinkOut = config:GetAttribute("SinkOut") ~= false
	data.HitPerChunk = config:GetAttribute("HitPerChunk") == true
	data.InheritFloor = config:GetAttribute("InheritFloor") == true

	data.Scale = config:GetAttribute("Scale")
	data.Color = config:GetAttribute("Color")
	data.Brightness = config:GetAttribute("Brightness")
	data.Transparency = config:GetAttribute("Transparency")
	data.Timescale = config:GetAttribute("Timescale")

	data.Pool = config:GetAttribute("Pool")
	return data
end

function GetDataRig.readRope(data, item, config, safeEnum)
	data.PartLife = config:GetAttribute("PartLife") or 0
	data.Lifetime = config:GetAttribute("Lifetime") or NumberRange.new(2)
	data.Rate = config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 1

	data.SegmentCount = asRange(config:GetAttribute("SegmentCount"), NumberRange.new(12))
	data.PinMode = config:GetAttribute("PinMode") or "BothEnds"
	local targetValue = item:FindFirstChild("Target")
	data.Target = (targetValue and targetValue:IsA("ObjectValue")) and targetValue.Value or nil
	data.RopeLength = asRange(config:GetAttribute("RopeLength"), NumberRange.new(0))
	data.Slack = config:GetAttribute("Slack") or 1.2

	data.Stiffness = config:GetAttribute("Stiffness") or 4
	data.Damping = config:GetAttribute("Damping") or 0.03
	data.Gravity = config:GetAttribute("Gravity") or Vector3.new(0, -40, 0)
	data.WindAmplitude = asRange(config:GetAttribute("WindAmplitude"), NumberRange.new(0))
	data.WindFrequency = config:GetAttribute("WindFrequency") or 2

	data.SpawnTarget = config:GetAttribute("SpawnTarget") or "Start"
	data.PosX = asRange(config:GetAttribute("PosX"), NumberRange.new(0))

-- Graph  -  sampling primitives for NumberSequence + ColorSequence graphs.
-- Seed shape: {[keypointIndex] = number}. Single intensity per seed correlates drift
-- across keypoints (adjacent points drift together instead of jittering independently).

local function clamp(x, a, b) if x < a then return a end if x > b then return b end return x end
local function lerp(a, b, t) return a + (b - a) * t end

local Graph = {}

-- Roll a fresh envelope seed; each keypoint gets ±intensity*Envelope (one intensity, one sign).
function Graph.GenerateSeed(graph: NumberSequence?)
	local seed = {}
	-- Legacy items can lack newly-added graphs; empty seed → QueryPointsWithTime falls through.
	if not graph or typeof(graph) ~= "NumberSequence" then return seed end
	local kp = graph.Keypoints
	local intensity = math.random()
	local isPositive = math.random() >= 0.5
	for i = 1, #kp do
		if kp[i].Envelope > 0 then
			if isPositive then
				seed[i] = intensity * kp[i].Envelope
			else
				seed[i] = -intensity * kp[i].Envelope
			end
		end
	end
	return seed
end

function Graph.GenerateSeeds(graph: NumberSequence, NoOfSeeds: number)
	local seeds = {}
	for i = 1, NoOfSeeds do
		seeds[i] = Graph.GenerateSeed(graph)
	end
	return seeds
end

-- Sample a NumberSequence at t∈[0,1] with optional envelope seed.
function Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(t: number, graph: NumberSequence, seed: {number})
	t = math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
	local keypoints = graph.Keypoints
	local n = #keypoints

	if n == 1 then return keypoints[1].Value + (seed[1] or 0) end

	local lo, hi = 1, n
	while lo < hi - 1 do
		local mid = (lo + hi) // 2
		if keypoints[mid].Time <= t then lo = mid else hi = mid end
	end
	local k1 = keypoints[lo]
	local k2 = keypoints[lo + 1]
	local span = k2.Time - k1.Time
	local point = span > 0 and (t - k1.Time) / span or 0
	local k1value = k1.Value + (seed[lo] or 0)
	local k2value = k2.Value + (seed[lo + 1] or 0)
	return k1value + ((k2value - k1value) * point)
end

-- Sample a ColorSequence at t∈[0,1]. ColorSequences have no envelope, so no seed.
function Graph.QueryColorPointWithTime(t: number, graph: ColorSequence)
	t = math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
	local kp = graph.Keypoints
	local n = #kp
	if n == 0 then return Color3.new(1, 1, 1) end
	if n == 1 then return kp[1].Value end
	if t <= kp[1].Time then return kp[1].Value end

	local lo, hi = 1, n
	while lo < hi - 1 do
		local mid = (lo + hi) // 2
		if kp[mid].Time <= t then lo = mid else hi = mid end
	end
	local k1 = kp[lo]
	local k2 = kp[lo + 1]
	local span = k2.Time - k1.Time
	local point = span > 0 and (t - k1.Time) / span or 0
	return k1.Value:Lerp(k2.Value, point)
end

-- Trapezoidal integral of a NumberSequence over [0, t]. Used by TextureSpeed.
function Graph.IntegrateUpTo(t: number, sequence: NumberSequence, seed: {number}): number
	t = math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
	local keypoints = sequence.Keypoints
	local n = #keypoints
	if n == 0 then return 0 end
	if n == 1 then return (keypoints[1].Value + (seed[1] or 0)) * t end

	local total = 0
	for i = 1, n - 1 do
		local k1 = keypoints[i]
		local k2 = keypoints[i + 1]
		if t <= k1.Time then break end

		local v1 = k1.Value + (seed[i] or 0)
		local v2 = k2.Value + (seed[i + 1] or 0)
		local segEnd = math.min(t, k2.Time)
		local segLength = segEnd - k1.Time
		local span = k2.Time - k1.Time
		local alpha = span > 0 and (segEnd - k1.Time) / span or 0
		local vEnd = v1 + (v2 - v1) * alpha

		total = total + (v1 + vEnd) / 2 * segLength
		if t <= k2.Time then break end
	end
	return total
end

-- True if the sequence produces a constant value (single keypoint zero-envelope or all-equal).
function Graph.IsStatic(sequence: NumberSequence): boolean
	if not sequence then return true end
	local kps = sequence.Keypoints
	-- Non-zero envelope → per-particle randomness, so not static.
	if #kps == 1 then return kps[1].Envelope == 0 end
	local val = kps[1].Value
	if kps[1].Envelope ~= 0 then return false end
	for i = 2, #kps do
		if kps[i].Value ~= val or kps[i].Envelope ~= 0 then return false end
	end
	return true
end

function Graph.GetStaticValue(sequence: NumberSequence, defaultValue: number): number
	if not sequence or #sequence.Keypoints == 0 then
		return defaultValue
	end
	return sequence.Keypoints[1].Value
end

-- Merge unique sorted times from two NumberSequence or ColorSequence (both expose Keypoints[].Time).
local function _mergeSequenceTimes(seqA, seqB)
	local times = {}
	local seen = {}
	for _, seq in ipairs({seqA, seqB}) do
		for _, kp in ipairs(seq.Keypoints) do
			if not seen[kp.Time] then
				seen[kp.Time] = true
				table.insert(times, kp.Time)
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(times)
	return times
end

function Graph.BlendGraphWithTime(GraphA: NumberSequence, GraphB: NumberSequence, SpeedGraph: NumberSequence, alpha: number)
	alpha = clamp(alpha or 1, 0, 1)
	local times = _mergeSequenceTimes(GraphA, GraphB)
	local blendFactor = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(alpha, SpeedGraph, {})

	local newKps = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(times) do
		local valA = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(t, GraphA, {})
		local valB = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(t, GraphB, {})
		table.insert(newKps, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t, lerp(valA, valB, blendFactor)))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(newKps)
end

function Graph.BlendColorGraphWithTime(GraphA: ColorSequence, GraphB: ColorSequence, SpeedGraph: NumberSequence, alpha: number)
	alpha = clamp(alpha or 1, 0, 1)
	local times = _mergeSequenceTimes(GraphA, GraphB)
	local blendFactor = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(alpha, SpeedGraph, {})

	local newKps = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(times) do
		local colorA = Graph.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, GraphA)
		local colorB = Graph.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, GraphB)
		table.insert(newKps, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(t, colorA:Lerp(colorB, blendFactor)))
	end
	return ColorSequence.new(newKps)
end

-- Linear blend between two NumberSequences at alpha (no speed graph). Beam graph blender.
function Graph.LerpGraph(GraphA: NumberSequence, GraphB: NumberSequence, alpha: number): NumberSequence
	alpha = clamp(alpha or 0, 0, 1)
	local times = _mergeSequenceTimes(GraphA, GraphB)
	local newKps = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(times) do
		local valA = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(t, GraphA, {})
		local valB = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(t, GraphB, {})
		table.insert(newKps, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t, lerp(valA, valB, alpha)))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(newKps)
end

function Graph.LerpColorGraph(GraphA: ColorSequence, GraphB: ColorSequence, alpha: number): ColorSequence
	alpha = clamp(alpha or 0, 0, 1)
	local times = _mergeSequenceTimes(GraphA, GraphB)
	local newKps = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(times) do
		local colorA = Graph.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, GraphA)
		local colorB = Graph.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, GraphB)
		table.insert(newKps, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(t, colorA:Lerp(colorB, alpha)))
	end
	return ColorSequence.new(newKps)
end

-- Cache merged times once at emit time so per-frame LerpGraphFast skips the merge.
function Graph.PrecomputeMergedTimes(GraphA: NumberSequence, GraphB: NumberSequence): {number}
	return _mergeSequenceTimes(GraphA, GraphB)
end

function Graph.PrecomputeMergedColorTimes(GraphA: ColorSequence, GraphB: ColorSequence): {number}
	return _mergeSequenceTimes(GraphA, GraphB)
end

-- Endpoint short-circuit: alpha 0/1 returns the source sequence to skip per-frame allocation.
function Graph.LerpGraphFast(GraphA: NumberSequence, GraphB: NumberSequence, alpha: number, mergedTimes: {number}): NumberSequence
	alpha = clamp(alpha or 0, 0, 1)
	if alpha == 0 then return GraphA end
	if alpha == 1 then return GraphB end
	local newKps = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(mergedTimes) do
		local valA = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(t, GraphA, {})
		local valB = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(t, GraphB, {})
		table.insert(newKps, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t, lerp(valA, valB, alpha)))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(newKps)
end

function Graph.LerpColorGraphFast(GraphA: ColorSequence, GraphB: ColorSequence, alpha: number, mergedTimes: {number}): ColorSequence
	alpha = clamp(alpha or 0, 0, 1)
	if alpha == 0 then return GraphA end
	if alpha == 1 then return GraphB end
	local newKps = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(mergedTimes) do
		local colorA = Graph.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, GraphA)
		local colorB = Graph.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, GraphB)
		table.insert(newKps, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(t, colorA:Lerp(colorB, alpha)))
	end
	return ColorSequence.new(newKps)
end

-- Collect Beam GraphBlender states from Configuration children (Time/Transparency/Color attrs).
-- A state's optional Transition graph eases the blend INTO it (x = linear segment alpha).
function Graph.CollectGraphStates(graphBlender)
	local transStates, colorStates = {}, {}
	if not graphBlender then return transStates, colorStates end

	for _, child in pairs(graphBlender:GetChildren()) do
		if not child:IsA("Configuration") then continue end
		local time = child:GetAttribute("Time")
		if time == nil then
			local num = tonumber(string.match(child.Name, "%d+"))
			time = num and (num - 1) or 0
		end
		local transition = child:GetAttribute("Transition")
		if typeof(transition) ~= "NumberSequence" then transition = nil end
		local trans = child:GetAttribute("Transparency")
		if trans and typeof(trans) == "NumberSequence" then
			table.insert(transStates, {Time = time, Graph = trans, Transition = transition})
		end
		local color = child:GetAttribute("Color")
		if color and typeof(color) == "ColorSequence" then
			table.insert(colorStates, {Time = time, Graph = color, Transition = transition})
		end
	end

	table.sort(transStates, function(a, b) return a.Time < b.Time end)
	table.sort(colorStates, function(a, b) return a.Time < b.Time end)
	-- Normalize fallback values into 0-1 range.
	for _, states in ipairs({transStates, colorStates}) do
		if #states > 1 and states[#states].Time > 1 then
			local maxTime = states[#states].Time
			if maxTime > 0 then for _, s in ipairs(states) do s.Time = s.Time / maxTime end end
		end
	end

	return transStates, colorStates
end

-- Initial _effectiveElapsed for a particle whose Timescale starts negative.
-- ts(0) < 0 → start at end of life (i=1), rewind to 0; otherwise start at 0.
function Graph.InitialEffectiveElapsed(graph, seed, lifeTime)
	if not graph or typeof(graph) ~= "NumberSequence" then return 0 end
	-- Empty seed fallback: i=0 is deterministic on the first keypoint regardless of envelope.
	local ts0 = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(0, graph, seed or {})
	return (ts0 < 0) and lifeTime or 0
end

-- Scale a NumberSequence: values *= factor, envelopes *= abs(factor).
function Graph.ScaleSequence(seq, factor)
	if not seq or typeof(seq) ~= "NumberSequence" then return seq end
	local kps = seq.Keypoints
	local new = {}
	local absFactor = math.abs(factor)
	for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
		table.insert(new, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.Time, kp.Value * factor, kp.Envelope * absFactor))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(new)
end

return Graph

-- GuiHost  -  resolve correct container for plugin-internal singleton ScreenGuis

--[[
	Highlight Mixin  -  Emit + Update for Highlight particles.
	Non-spatial (no motion). Animates FillColor / FillTransparency / OutlineColor /
	OutlineTransparency over Lifetime via NumberSequence + ColorSequence graphs. Adornee
	resolved at emit: ObjectValue child → link (nested emit adorns the emitted parent
	clone) → source.Adornee → source.Parent.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)

return function(Particle)

-- Per-frame Heartbeat update for Highlight particles. Samples FillColor / FillTransparency /
-- OutlineColor / OutlineTransparency graphs at the current life step, with SetTimescale override
-- gating the time-axis.
function Particle:UpdateHighlight(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse timescale support: see Update.luau UpdatePart. SetTimescale override wins for its window.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	local dtTs = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dtTs)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsedTime = newEff
	local i = elapsedTime / lifeTime

	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	i = math.min(math.max(i, 0), 1)

	local targetStep = math.floor(i * pData.TotalKeyFrames)

	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		local steppedI = pData.CurrentStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames

		if pData.Graphs.HLFillColor and not pData.SkipColor then
			pData.VisualPart.FillColor = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.HLFillColor)
		end
		if pData.Graphs.HLFillTransparency and not pData.SkipTransparency then
			pData.VisualPart.FillTransparency = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.HLFillTransparency, pData.Seeds.HLFillTransparency)
		end
		if pData.Graphs.HLOutlineColor and not pData.SkipColor then
			pData.VisualPart.OutlineColor = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.HLOutlineColor)
		end
		if pData.Graphs.HLOutlineTransparency and not pData.SkipTransparency then
			pData.VisualPart.OutlineTransparency = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.HLOutlineTransparency, pData.Seeds.HLOutlineTransparency)
		end
	end

	return isDying
end

-- Adornee resolution: ObjectValue child → link → source.Adornee → source.Parent IF it's a BasePart
-- or Model (highlightable). link is the emitted parent clone during nested emit — adorning it makes
-- the highlight track the particle instead of the hidden source RenderTemplate. Attachment links
-- adorn their holder part. Returning nil silently skips rendering  -  better than accidentally
-- Adorneeing Workspace and highlighting the whole place.
local function _resolveAdornee(data, source, link)
	if data.Adornee then return data.Adornee end
	if link then
		if link:IsA("BasePart") or link:IsA("Model") then return link end
		if link:IsA("Attachment") then
			local holder = link.Parent
			if holder and (holder:IsA("BasePart") or holder:IsA("Model")) then return holder end
		end
	end
	local cur = source.Adornee
	if cur then return cur end
	local p = source.Parent
	if p and (p:IsA("BasePart") or p:IsA("Model")) then return p end
	return nil
end

-- Spawn a Highlight particle: clones RenderTemplate, resolves Adornee, registers in ActiveEmits.
function Particle:EmitHighlight(highlight, link, emitCtx)
	if not highlight or not highlight.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(highlight, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	-- PoolHide flipped Enabled=false on release; flip back here.
	local visual = Pool.acquireOrClone(data.RenderTemplate, "Highlight", data.Pool)
	visual.Archivable = false
	visual.Enabled = true
	if data.HLDepthMode then visual.DepthMode = data.HLDepthMode end
	visual.Adornee = _resolveAdornee(data, highlight, link)
	-- Renders through Adornee; the instance lives in a local clone or the live folder, never the user's part.
	local parentInstance = data.EmitParent or link or self:GetFolder()

	local safeLifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if safeLifeTime <= 0 then safeLifeTime = 0.001 end

	local seedFillTrans = data.HLFillTransparency and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.HLFillTransparency) or {}
	local seedOutlineTrans = data.HLOutlineTransparency and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.HLOutlineTransparency) or {}
	local seedTimescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.HLTimescale)

	-- Apply initial values before parenting (1-frame pop prevention).
	if data.HLFillColor then
		visual.FillColor = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(0, data.HLFillColor)
	end
	if data.HLFillTransparency then
		visual.FillTransparency = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.HLFillTransparency, seedFillTrans)
	end
	if data.HLOutlineColor then
		visual.OutlineColor = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(0, data.HLOutlineColor)
	end
	if data.HLOutlineTransparency then
		visual.OutlineTransparency = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.HLOutlineTransparency, seedOutlineTrans)
	end

	visual.Parent = parentInstance

	local pData = {
		Type = "Highlight",
		VisualPart = visual,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = safeLifeTime,
		PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,

		Graphs = {
			HLFillColor = data.HLFillColor,
			HLFillTransparency = data.HLFillTransparency,
			HLOutlineColor = data.HLOutlineColor,
			HLOutlineTransparency = data.HLOutlineTransparency,
			Timescale = data.HLTimescale,
		},
		Seeds = {
			HLFillTransparency = seedFillTrans,
			HLOutlineTransparency = seedOutlineTrans,
			Timescale = seedTimescale,
		},
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.HLTimescale, seedTimescale, safeLifeTime),
	}

	pData._sourceItem = highlight
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, highlight)
	if data.Pool ~= false then pData._sourceRT, pData._poolKind = data.RenderTemplate, "Highlight" end
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
end

-- Animate mode: operate on live RenderTemplate (no clone). Lifecycle.cancelAnimation restores the
-- intrinsic FillColor / Transparency / OutlineColor / Transparency from BeamSnapshot-equivalent.
function Particle:EmitHighlightAnimate(highlight, link, emitCtx)
	if not highlight or not highlight.Parent then return end
	if self.ActiveAnimates[highlight] then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(highlight, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local visual = data.RenderTemplate -- LIVE source, not a clone

	-- Snapshot BEFORE mutating so cancelAnimation restores authored values (mirrors Beam pattern).
	local snapshot = {
		FillColor = visual.FillColor,
		FillTransparency = visual.FillTransparency,
		OutlineColor = visual.OutlineColor,
		OutlineTransparency = visual.OutlineTransparency,
		DepthMode = visual.DepthMode,
		Adornee = visual.Adornee,
		Enabled = visual.Enabled,
	}

	visual.Enabled = true
	if data.HLDepthMode then visual.DepthMode = data.HLDepthMode end
	visual.Adornee = _resolveAdornee(data, highlight, link)

	local safeLifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if safeLifeTime <= 0 then safeLifeTime = 0.001 end

	local seedFillTrans = data.HLFillTransparency and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.HLFillTransparency) or {}
	local seedOutlineTrans = data.HLOutlineTransparency and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.HLOutlineTransparency) or {}
	local seedTimescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.HLTimescale)

	local pData = {
		Type = "Highlight",
		VisualPart = visual,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = safeLifeTime,
		PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,
		IsAnimate = true,
		AnimateItem = highlight,
		HighlightSnapshot = snapshot,

		Graphs = {
			HLFillColor = data.HLFillColor,
			HLFillTransparency = data.HLFillTransparency,
			HLOutlineColor = data.HLOutlineColor,
			HLOutlineTransparency = data.HLOutlineTransparency,
			Timescale = data.HLTimescale,
		},
		Seeds = {
			HLFillTransparency = seedFillTrans,
			HLOutlineTransparency = seedOutlineTrans,
			Timescale = seedTimescale,
		},
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.HLTimescale, seedTimescale, safeLifeTime),
	}

	pData._sourceItem = highlight
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, highlight)
	self.ActiveAnimates[highlight] = pData
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
end

end

--[[
	HitFilter  -  type-level raycast filter for one emitter: a collision group + an exclude list,
	stored on PartIcleProperties as the HitFilterGroup attribute and the HitFilterExclude folder of
	ObjectValues. Read by Events.makeHitParams (OnHit), Rocks and Lightning Seek; written by the
	HitFilterPanel. Requires TypeRegistry only.
]]

local TypeRegistry = require(script.Parent.TypeRegistry)

local HitFilter = {}

local GROUP_ATTR = "HitFilterGroup"
local FOLDER_NAME = "HitFilterExclude"

local function getConfig(item)
	if not item then return nil end
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
	if not typeDef or typeDef.directAccess then return nil end
	return TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
end

local function readExcludes(folder, out)
	if not folder then return out end
	for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("ObjectValue") and child.Value then table.insert(out, child.Value) end
	end
	return out
end

-- Legacy location: the OnHit event cfg's CollisionGroup attribute + ExcludeList folder.
local function legacyEventCfg(config)
	local events = config:FindFirstChild("Events")
	local cfg = events and events:FindFirstChild("OnHit")
	if cfg and cfg:IsA("Configuration") then return cfg end
	return nil
end

--- Returns the group name ("" = unset) and an array of excluded Instances. Falls back to the
--- legacy per-event location until migrateFromEvent has run.
function HitFilter.read(item)
	local config = getConfig(item)
	if not config then return "", {} end
	local group = config:GetAttribute(GROUP_ATTR)
	if type(group) ~= "string" then group = "" end
	local excludes = readExcludes(config:FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME), {})
	if group == "" and #excludes == 0 then
		local legacy = legacyEventCfg(config)
		if legacy then
			local legacyGroup = legacy:GetAttribute("CollisionGroup")
			if type(legacyGroup) == "string" then group = legacyGroup end
			readExcludes(legacy:FindFirstChild("ExcludeList"), excludes)
		end
	end
	return group, excludes
end

--- "" or nil clears the group.
function HitFilter.setGroup(item, groupName)
	local config = getConfig(item)
	if not config then return false end
	if type(groupName) ~= "string" or groupName == "" then groupName = nil end
	config:SetAttribute(GROUP_ATTR, groupName)
	return true
end

local function excludeFolder(config, create)
	local folder = config:FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if folder or not create then return folder end
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = FOLDER_NAME
	folder.Parent = config
	return folder
end

function HitFilter.addExclude(item, inst)
	local config = getConfig(item)
	if not config or not inst then return false end
	local folder = excludeFolder(config, true)
	for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("ObjectValue") and child.Value == inst then return false end
	end
	local objectValue = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
	objectValue.Name = "Exclude"
	objectValue.Value = inst
	objectValue.Parent = folder
	return true
end

function HitFilter.removeExclude(item, inst)
	local config = getConfig(item)
	local folder = config and excludeFolder(config, false)
	if not folder then return false end
	local removed = false
	for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("ObjectValue") and child.Value == inst then
			child:Destroy()
			removed = true
		end
	end
	if #folder:GetChildren() == 0 then folder:Destroy() end
	return removed
end

--- Move a legacy per-event filter (OnHit cfg CollisionGroup + ExcludeList) to the type level.
--- Existing type-level values win. `cfg` defaults to the item's OnHit cfg. Returns true when
--- anything changed.
function HitFilter.migrateFromEvent(item, cfg)
	local config = getConfig(item)
	if not config then return false end
	cfg = cfg or legacyEventCfg(config)
	if not cfg then return false end
	local changed = false
	local legacyGroup = cfg:GetAttribute("CollisionGroup")
	if legacyGroup ~= nil then
		if type(legacyGroup) == "string" and legacyGroup ~= "" and config:GetAttribute(GROUP_ATTR) == nil then
			config:SetAttribute(GROUP_ATTR, legacyGroup)
		end
		cfg:SetAttribute("CollisionGroup", nil)
		changed = true
	end
	local legacy = cfg:FindFirstChild("ExcludeList")
	if legacy then
		for _, inst in ipairs(readExcludes(legacy, {})) do HitFilter.addExclude(item, inst) end
		legacy:Destroy()
		changed = true
	end
	return changed
end

return HitFilter

-- ImageEmit  -  Emit/Animate/Update for ImageLabel emitters.
-- 2D screen-space motion + flipbook (own Heartbeat branch, Type="ImageLabel").
-- Position = (Speed*direction + envVel) * dt; Acceleration + Drag drive envVel.

local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local ScreenHost = require(script.Parent.ScreenHost)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)
local StaticPass = require(script.Parent.StaticPass)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Log)

return function(Particle)

-- Dedup keyed on Image asset ID so a noisy emit (rate=100/s) prints once per session.
local _warnedSheets = {}

-- Parent priority: EmitParent > the parent clone's copy of the source Gui (nested-driven) >
-- nearest _PartIcleEmit ancestor (ImageLabel-in-ImageLabel clone walk) > ScreenHost.
local function resolveImageParent(data, source, emitCtx)
	if data.EmitParent then return data.EmitParent end
	local map = emitCtx and emitCtx._parentCloneMap
	if map and source and source.Parent and map[source.Parent] then return map[source.Parent] end
	if source then
		local cur = source.Parent
		while cur and cur ~= game do
			if cur:GetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit") then return source.Parent end
			cur = cur.Parent
		end
	end
	return ScreenHost.get()
end

-- Sorted Decal children of ImageFlipbooks (numeric name).
local function gatherFlipbookDecals(folder)
	if not folder then return nil end
	local list = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Decal") then table.insert(list, child) end
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		local an, bn = tonumber(a.Name), tonumber(b.Name)
		if an and bn then return an < bn end
		return a.Name < b.Name
	end)
	return #list > 0 and list or nil
end

-- Fire-and-forget PreloadAsync; ContentProvider de-dupes.
local function preloadEmitAssets(data, decals)
	local assetList = {}
	if decals then for _, d in ipairs(decals) do table.insert(assetList, d) end end
	if data.Image and data.Image ~= "" then table.insert(assetList, data.Image) end
	if #assetList == 0 then return end
	task.spawn(function() pcall(ContentProvider.PreloadAsync, ContentProvider, assetList) end)
end

-- Yielding PreloadAsync on first emit per RT. Memoized on Particle._preloadedAssets
-- so subsequent emits of the same source skip the yield.
local function preloadAndWait(particle, rt, data, decals)
	if not particle or not rt then return end
	local cache = particle._preloadedAssets
	if not cache then return end
	if cache[rt] then return end
	local assetList = {}
	if decals then for _, d in ipairs(decals) do table.insert(assetList, d) end end
	if data.Image and data.Image ~= "" then table.insert(assetList, data.Image) end
	cache[rt] = true  -- mark before yield so concurrent emits don't double-wait
	if #assetList == 0 then return end
	pcall(ContentProvider.PreloadAsync, ContentProvider, assetList)
end

-- Frame index per FlipbookMode. OneShot/PingPong scale across Lifetime; Loop uses framerate;
-- Random picks one per interval (per-pData state). StartRandom only affects Loop.
local function resolveFrame(pData, n, elapsed)
	if n <= 0 then return 0 end
	local mode = pData.FlipbookMode
	local frame
	if mode == Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot then
		local t = pData.LifeTime > 0 and math.min(1, elapsed / pData.LifeTime) or 1
		frame = math.min(math.floor(t * n), n - 1)
	elseif mode == Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.PingPong then
		local t = pData.LifeTime > 0 and math.min(1, elapsed / pData.LifeTime) or 1
		local cyc = t * 2
		if cyc <= 1 then frame = math.floor(cyc * n) else frame = math.floor((2 - cyc) * n) end
		frame = math.max(0, math.min(frame, n - 1))
	elseif mode == Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.Random then
		local fr = pData.FlipbookFramerate or 24
		local interval = (fr > 0) and (1 / fr) or 1
		local intervalIdx = math.floor(elapsed / interval)
		if pData._lastRandomInterval ~= intervalIdx then
			pData._lastRandomInterval = intervalIdx
			pData._currentRandomFrame = math.random(0, n - 1)
		end
		frame = pData._currentRandomFrame or math.random(0, n - 1)
	else -- Loop (default)
		local raw = elapsed * pData.FlipbookFramerate + (pData.FlipbookStartOffset or 0) * n
		frame = math.floor(raw) % n
	end
	if pData.FlipbookReverse then frame = n - 1 - frame end
	return frame
end

-- Decals: swap .Image; Spritesheet: shift ImageRectOffset across a grid.
-- lastFrame dedup: skip the property write when frame index hasn't changed.
local function applyFlipbookFrame(pData, elapsed)
	if not pData.FlipbookFramerate or pData.FlipbookFramerate <= 0 then return end
	if pData.FlipbookSource == "Decals" and pData.FlipbookDecals then
		local n = #pData.FlipbookDecals
		if n == 0 then return end
		local frame = resolveFrame(pData, n, elapsed)
		if frame == pData._lastFlipbookFrame then return end
		pData._lastFlipbookFrame = frame
		local dec = pData.FlipbookDecals[frame + 1]
		if dec and dec.Texture then pData.VisualPart.Image = dec.Texture end
	elseif pData.FlipbookSource == "Spritesheet" then
		local cols = math.max(1, pData.GridCols or 1)
		local rows = math.max(1, pData.GridRows or 1)
		local total = cols * rows
		local frame = resolveFrame(pData, total, elapsed)
		local sheet = pData.SheetSize
		if not sheet then return end
		if frame == pData._lastFlipbookFrame then return end
		pData._lastFlipbookFrame = frame
		local fw, fh = sheet.X / cols, sheet.Y / rows
		pData.VisualPart.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(fw, fh)
		pData.VisualPart.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new((frame % cols) * fw, math.floor(frame / cols) * fh)
	end
end

-- Forward-integrate 2D motion over Lifetime and return final (endX, endY, endVelX,
-- endVelY). Mirrors UpdateImageLabel's per-frame math (Speed graph × 100 + Accel
-- × 100 + Drag decay), at coarse 60-step granularity. Used to seed InvertMotion's
-- spawn pose: position = end-pos, EnvVel = end-vel. Negative-dt integration then
-- retraces the forward trajectory exactly (accel-driven motion only reverses
-- correctly when starting EnvVel is the forward end-state, not zero).
local function _simulateForward2D(data, dirX, dirY, lifetime, seeds)
	local steps = 60
	local stepDt = lifetime / steps
	local accelX = (data.ImgAcceleration or Vector2.new()).X
	local accelY = (data.ImgAcceleration or Vector2.new()).Y
	local drag = data.ImgDrag or 0
	local posX, posY = 0, 0
	local envX, envY = 0, 0
	for s = 1, steps do
		local t = s / steps
		local speed = 0
		if data.ImgSpeed then
			speed = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, data.ImgSpeed, seeds.ImgSpeed) * 100
		end
		envX += accelX * 100 * stepDt
		envY += accelY * 100 * stepDt
		if drag > 0 then
			local decay = math.max(0, 1 - drag * stepDt)
			envX *= decay; envY *= decay
		end
		posX += (speed * dirX + envX) * stepDt
		posY += (speed * dirY + envY) * stepDt
	end
	return posX, posY, envX, envY
end

-- Expose so Engine.luau's AnimateLoop replay can re-seed end-state per cycle.
Particle._computeImageLabelEndState = function(_self, data, dirX, dirY, lifetime, seeds)
	return _simulateForward2D(data, dirX, dirY, lifetime, seeds)
end

-- Build pData from data; shared by Emit + Animate.
local function buildImageLabelPData(data, visual, item, isAnimate)
	-- One walk + sort of ImageFlipbooks per emit; reused by frame-0 setup + pData stamp.
	local flipbookDecals = gatherFlipbookDecals(data.ImageFlipbooks)
	-- EmissionAngle: 0=right, 90=up, 180=left, 270=down. GUI Y is inverted.
	local ea = data.ImgEmissionAngle or 90
	local sp = data.ImgSpreadAngle or 0
	local angle = ea + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * sp
	local rad = math.rad(angle)
	local dx, dy = math.cos(rad), -math.sin(rad)
	-- InvertMotion: spawn at trajectory's END position + flip dt sign per frame so
	-- motion retraces backward to the original start. Don't flip dx/dy  -  velocity
	-- direction stays forward; the dt sign is what reverses traversal.

	local safeLife = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if safeLife <= 0 then safeLife = 0.001 end

	local seeds = {
		ImageTransparency      = data.ImageTransparency and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.ImageTransparency) or {},
		BackgroundTransparency = data.BackgroundTransparency and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.BackgroundTransparency) or {},
		ImgSpeed               = data.ImgSpeed and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.ImgSpeed) or {},
		ImgRotSpeed            = data.ImgRotSpeed and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.ImgRotSpeed) or {},
		SizeScaleX             = data.SizeScaleX and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.SizeScaleX) or {},
		SizeScaleY             = data.SizeScaleY and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.SizeScaleY) or {},
		Timescale              = data.ImgTimescale and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.ImgTimescale) or {},
	}

	local initialRot = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.ImgRotRange or NumberRange.new(0))
	local baseSize = data.ImgSizeUDim or UDim2.fromOffset(100, 100)

	-- Frame 0 sample to avoid pop.
	if data.ImageTransparency then visual.ImageTransparency = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.ImageTransparency, seeds.ImageTransparency) end
	if data.BackgroundTransparency then visual.BackgroundTransparency = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.BackgroundTransparency, seeds.BackgroundTransparency) end
	if data.ImageColor3 then visual.ImageColor3 = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(0, data.ImageColor3) end
	if data.BackgroundColor3 then visual.BackgroundColor3 = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(0, data.BackgroundColor3) end
	visual.Image = data.Image or ""
	visual.ScaleType = data.ImgScaleType or Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
	visual.ResampleMode = data.ImgResampleMode or Enum.ResamplerMode.Default
	visual.AnchorPoint = data.ImgAnchorPoint or Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	visual.ZIndex = data.ImgZIndex or 1
	visual.Rotation = initialRot
	local sx0 = data.SizeScaleX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.SizeScaleX, seeds.SizeScaleX) or 1
	local sy0 = data.SizeScaleY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.SizeScaleY, seeds.SizeScaleY) or 1
	visual.Size = UDim2.new(baseSize.X.Scale * sx0, baseSize.X.Offset * sx0, baseSize.Y.Scale * sy0, baseSize.Y.Offset * sy0)
	visual.Position = data.ImgPosition or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)

	local framerate = 10
	if data.ImgFlipbookFramerate then framerate = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.ImgFlipbookFramerate) end

	-- StartRandom is Loop-only (resolveFrame ignores FlipbookStartOffset for
	-- OneShot / PingPong / Random). One shared start frame for visual setup +
	-- Loop runtime offset so the first Heartbeat doesn't snap to a different frame.
	local mode = data.ImgFlipbookMode or Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.Loop
	local applyStartRandom = data.ImgFlipbookStartRandom and mode == Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.Loop
	local startFrame = 0
	local startFrameOffset = 0

	-- Sheet size missing → whole-sheet render. Decals mode ignores SheetSize.
	local sheetSize = data.SheetSize

	-- Frame-0 flipbook setup so first tick isn't stuck on base Image.
	local source = data.ImgFlipbookSource or "Decals"
	-- Spritesheet mode silently no-ops both crop paths when SheetSize is nil (HTTP fetchAndStamp
	-- pending, denied, or worker 404). Warn once per asset so user gets an actionable diagnostic
	-- instead of staring at a full-sheet emit.
	if source == "Spritesheet" and not sheetSize and data.Image and data.Image ~= "" and not _warnedSheets[data.Image] then
		_warnedSheets[data.Image] = true
		Log.warn(string.format("Part-Icles: Spritesheet flipbook  -  sheet dimensions unknown for %s. Emit will render full sheet until dimensions resolve.", data.Image))
	end
	if source == "Decals" then
		-- Reset lingering Spritesheet crop.
		visual.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(0, 0); visual.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(0, 0)
		if flipbookDecals and #flipbookDecals > 0 then
			local n = #flipbookDecals
			if applyStartRandom then
				startFrame = math.random(0, n - 1)
				startFrameOffset = startFrame / n
			end
			local dec = flipbookDecals[startFrame + 1]
			if dec and dec.Texture and dec.Texture ~= "" then visual.Image = dec.Texture end
		end
	elseif source == "Spritesheet" and sheetSize then
		local cols = math.max(1, data.ImgGridCols or 1)
		local rows = math.max(1, data.ImgGridRows or 1)
		local total = cols * rows
		if applyStartRandom and total > 0 then
			startFrame = math.random(0, total - 1)
			startFrameOffset = startFrame / total
		end
		local fw, fh = sheetSize.X / cols, sheetSize.Y / rows
		visual.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(fw, fh)
		visual.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new((startFrame % cols) * fw, math.floor(startFrame / cols) * fh)
	end

	local pData = {
		Type = "ImageLabel",
		VisualPart = visual,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		LifeTime = safeLife,
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames or 100),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,

		BasePosition = data.ImgPosition or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		BaseSize = baseSize,
		DirX = dx, DirY = dy,
		EnvVelX = 0, EnvVelY = 0,
		PosX = 0,  PosY = 0,
		AccelX = (data.ImgAcceleration or Vector2.new()).X,
		AccelY = (data.ImgAcceleration or Vector2.new()).Y,
		Drag = data.ImgDrag or 0,

		InitialRotation = initialRot,
		RotMode = data.ImgRotMode or "OverLife",
		AccRot = 0,
		InvertMotion = data.ImgInvertMotion or false,

		Graphs = {
			ImageTransparency      = data.ImageTransparency,
			BackgroundTransparency = data.BackgroundTransparency,
			ImgSpeed               = data.ImgSpeed,
			ImgRotSpeed            = data.ImgRotSpeed,
			SizeScaleX             = data.SizeScaleX,
			SizeScaleY             = data.SizeScaleY,
			ImageColor3            = data.ImageColor3,
			BackgroundColor3       = data.BackgroundColor3,
			Timescale              = data.ImgTimescale,
		},
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.ImgTimescale, seeds.Timescale, safeLife),

		FlipbookSource   = data.ImgFlipbookSource or "Decals",
		FlipbookMode     = data.ImgFlipbookMode or Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.Loop,
		FlipbookFramerate = framerate,
		FlipbookStartOffset = startFrameOffset,
		FlipbookReverse  = data.ImgFlipbookReverse or false,
		FlipbookDecals   = flipbookDecals,
		SheetSize = sheetSize,
		GridCols = data.ImgGridCols or 8,
		GridRows = data.ImgGridRows or 1,

		IsAnimate = isAnimate or nil,
		AnimateItem = isAnimate and item or nil,
	}

	-- InvertMotion: seed PosX/PosY + EnvVelX/Y to the forward trajectory's end-state
	-- and run elapsed counter from lifeTime back to 0 via per-frame _invertDtSign.
	-- EnvVel seed is required for accel-driven motion to reverse correctly  -  with
	-- EnvVel=0 the negative-dt integration accumulates accel in the wrong direction
	-- and doesn't retrace the forward path.
	if data.ImgInvertMotion then
		local endX, endY, endVelX, endVelY = _simulateForward2D(data, dx, dy, safeLife, seeds)
		pData.PosX, pData.PosY = endX, endY
		pData.EnvVelX, pData.EnvVelY = endVelX, endVelY
		pData._effectiveElapsed = safeLife
